purpose: Bridge bounded constraint obligations to SAT/SMT-style solvers without executing them or overstating solver evidence.

inputs.obligation: logic, constraints, assumptions, expected SAT or UNSAT, solver identity
inputs.raw_result: SAT, UNSAT, UNKNOWN, or ERROR plus optional model or unsat core

outputs.constraint_receipt: sealed obligation, matched expectation verdict, model/core, raw digest, and boundaries

refusals: SAT result without model when model required
